weakness: No MFA on the access control, video, and thermostat administrator accounts (owner and installer); email MFA by text message
remediation_plan: Turn on app-based MFA in all three building portals and for every remaining administrator; move email to an app; recovery codes into the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested in all five portals

weakness: Default router password; short, reused passwords saved in the browser; shared thermostat password never changed; no lost-fob procedure
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique 16+ character passphrases; clear the browser store; change the router password; lost-fob and revocation steps in POL-01 7.4
milestones: 2026-09-15 router password changed and passwords moved; 2026-09-30 browser store cleared

weakness: Lease application folder with guarantor data shared by an 'anyone with the link' link
source: P07 assessment (AC-03); P03 CPG 3.H; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
remediation_plan: Remove the public link; named share for the CPA; move guarantor files out of email into one restricted folder
milestones: 2026-08-05 link removed and CPA named share set up (done); 2026-09-15 files consolidated

weakness: HVAC contractor uses the owner's thermostat login
remediation_plan: Invite the contractor as its own limited user; change the owner's password
milestones: 2026-09-15 separate user created and owner password changed

weakness: No credential approval, departure notice, or review; 7 stale credentials; installer standing administrator accounts
remediation_plan: Rules letter to tenants and contractors (1-business-day departure notice); written credential requests; monthly review; remove installer standing accounts and grant time-limited ones per visit
milestones: 2026-07-24 7 stale credentials disabled (done); 2026-09-30 rules letter sent; 2026-10-31 first monthly review and installer accounts removed

weakness: No security terms, incident notice clauses, or vendor list for contractors
remediation_plan: One-page security terms (POL-01 6.1) signed by the installer, HVAC contractor, IT consultant, and janitorial contractor; vendor list

weakness: No owner-controlled backup of email, files, or the laptop; access control configuration never exported
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. to CP-09c.); P03 CPG 3.O
remediation_plan: SaaS backup of mail and files with version history; monthly access control export; laptop backup to an encrypted drive; restore test each July
milestones: 2026-10-31 backups running and first export saved; 2027-07-31 first restore test
resources_required: SaaS backup about $100 a year; drive about $80

weakness: Flat network: lobby Wi-Fi, cameras, door controllers, and thermostats together; router not monitored
source: P07 assessment (SC-07a.[01], a.[03], a.[04], b.); P03 CPG 3.I
remediation_plan: Interim: turn on guest isolation; then a business router with a separate building-device network and a guest network; check the device list monthly
milestones: 2026-09-15 guest isolation on; 2026-12-31 business router installed by the IT consultant
resources_required: Router about $250 plus 3 hours of consultant time

remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day (POL-01 7.8) with a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident
